briefs.speaker: Anna Wong
briefs.current_title: 安娜·王：就业数据分化，美联储政策何去何从？

subtitles.zh: 7月失业率下降与就业数据疲软的分化，主要源于家庭调查显示，16至24岁人群的劳动参与率持续下降。
subtitles.en: The difference between the falling unemployment rate on one hand and a very weak payroll on the other hand in a July sprint was mainly because in the household survey, it shows that the labor force participation continued to fall driven by

subtitles.zh: 这些人正在退出劳动力市场。由于劳动力池缩小，不需要大量新增就业，失业率就会下降。
subtitles.en: And those folks are dropping out of the labor market. And because you have a shrinking labor pool, you don't just don't need a lot of increase in hiring to cause an unemployment rate to go down.

subtitles.zh: 所以，失业率下降的原因并不健康。
subtitles.en: So it is a fall in unemployment rate that's due to the wrong reasons.

subtitles.zh: 失业率下降是因为人们放弃找工作。有趣的是，这主要集中在您提到的年龄段。
subtitles.en: Well, the unemployment went down because people gave up and stopped looking for work. It also seems an interesting indication that it's in those ages that you talked about.

subtitles.zh: 年轻人决定不申请这些工作。他们在做什么？是在等待进入职场吗？
subtitles.en: So it's younger people who are deciding not to be applying for these jobs. What are they doing? Are they waiting to enter the workforce?

subtitles.zh: 我认为这可能是更无害的解释。毕竟现在是7月，尤其是年轻人、等待上大学的学生，他们正在度假。
subtitles.en: I think it could be a more harmless explanation. It could be that it is July after all, and people, especially the younger folks, folks who are waiting to go to college, the college students themselves, they are just off vacationing.

subtitles.zh: 他们没有做通常的暑期工作，也没有在7月中旬寻找暑期工作。
subtitles.en: and they are just not working in their usual summer job and not looking for a summer job in the thick of July.

briefs.speaker: Anna Wong
briefs.current_title: 安娜·王：就业增长门槛降低，市场需适应新常态

subtitles.zh: 是的，他提到了这个盈亏平衡的概念。
subtitles.en: Yeah, so he mentioned this break even concept.

subtitles.zh: 经济学家估算维持失业率稳定所需的月度就业增长步伐，凯文·哈塞特提到他的估算是4万。
subtitles.en: So economists estimate this monthly pace of job growth that's needed to keep the unemployment rate constant, and Kevin Hassett just mentioned his estimate is 40,000.

subtitles.zh: 我们的估算约为5.5万。美联储在最近的报告中认为接近零。
subtitles.en: Our estimate is around 55,000. The Fed in a recent note, they think that it's closer to zero.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为凯文·哈塞特想表达的是，虽然我们习惯了每月10万级别的就业增长，
subtitles.en: So I think that's what he's trying to, Kevin Hassett is trying to say to kind of his point is that while we are used to the 100K type of monthly payrolls print going forward,

subtitles.zh: 即使是在0到5万之间的疲软数据，在他看来，4万也是可以接受且不错的就业增长。
subtitles.en: even a soft ones that's between zero to 50,000 and in his mind, 40,000 is actually a tolerable and decent kind of number of job growth.

subtitles.zh: 我认为他基本上是在降低好劳动力市场的标准。
subtitles.en: And I think basically he's lowering the bar for what constitutes a good labor market.

briefs.speaker: Anna Wong
briefs.current_title: 安娜·王：地方政府教育岗位大减，财政压力显现
current_title_lines: 地方政府教育岗位大减，

subtitles.zh: 是的，拖累最大的是地方政府教育部门，就业减少了5万。
subtitles.en: Yeah, so the places that produce the largest drag is local government education sector. And it saw a 50,000 decline in job growth.

subtitles.zh: 这个数字相当可观。我认为这种下降不容忽视，不能轻描淡写。
subtitles.en: That's pretty substantial. I think this is, this decrease is not worthy and it's not something that you can just sweep under the rug.

subtitles.zh: 我认为这是长期收益率曲线上升开始产生影响的迹象。
subtitles.en: I think this is a sign that the higher-long end of the yield curve that has been rising for the last three, four months already, that is starting to bite.

subtitles.zh: 长期国债收益率上升，给市场利率带来上行压力，这已经冷却了房地产市场。
subtitles.en: When you have higher-long term treasury yields, that puts upward pressure on market rates and that has been cooling the house-exactor.

subtitles.zh: 地方政府很大一部分收入来自当地地产市场。
subtitles.en: And you know, local government derive a lot of their revenue from the local property market.

subtitles.zh: 因此，当地方政府今年上半年预算不足时，进入新财年，他们能分配给学校的资金就会减少。
subtitles.en: So when local government's budget are falling short in the first half of this year, going into the new fiscal year, they will have less to allocate to schools.
